_comment: Names of document and puzzle markers. Documents: the Files-list names of the game (English: EXE item-name table; Korean: the Korean HD patch's name table, see documents_source.names); en_title/ko_title are the titles on the first page (bitmaps). Puzzles: one name per mechanism (see basis).

documents_source.method: Title = page 2 (4bpp 256x256 TIM) of Common/file/fileNN.bin (installed Korean HD patch) and fileNNu.bin (English); NN = item id - 104 (EXE 0x4fa864 adds 0x68). Pages are LZ-unpacked with the EXE's own decompressor 0x43c390 from raw[0x80+offset[2]:] (offset table = first 32 dwords). Titles were read from the bitmaps by eye; the Korean text is the patch's own title text, entries flagged ko_reading_uncertain need confirmation.

names.english: Resident Evil 2.exe (SHA-256 21b2a647...) file offset 0x12eb98 (VA 0x52eb98): 0xf7-terminated strings in the game font encoding (byte+36 = ASCII, 0 = space, '^' apostrophe, '_' dash); string n is the name of item id n. Per-document offset, VA and SHA-256 are in en_source; tools/mapgen/extract_doc_names.py checks them.
names.korean: korean.asi applies korean_hd.bin (KRP1) to the running game; its records `03 01 <table offset> <length> <bytes>` are the Korean item-name table (offsets contiguous from 0x800, f7-terminated, n-th record = item id n). `f1 xx`/`f2 xx` = cell xx / 252+xx of Common/Data/fontk1.adt (korean_rebirth.txt page 39), `f3 xx` = cell xx of the shared rows of Common/Data/font1..7.adt (page 9); 14x14 px cells, 18 per row. Per-document record offset, bytes and SHA-256 are in ko_source; cell readings in ko_glyphs. tools/mapgen/extract_ko_doc_names.py checks both against the game files.
names.japanese_code_table: The EXE's own Japanese-code table (base VA 0x52e580, offsets VA 0x52ea80, getter 0x4c9909) is what the patch replaces; its strings are Japanese (e.g. 119 ジョージの日記), so they are not the Korean names.
names.korean_items: Every item id of the map (key items, ammo, herbs, lock keys...) takes its Korean name from the same korean_hd.bin table (item_names_ko, with record offset, bytes and SHA-256 each); 0x01 = '.'. Area maps 200-205 are not in the table and keep the project's names.

210.basis: Rooftop (room 108): 'A water pressure valve. Excessive pressure may rupture the water tank.' The Valve Handle is used on the pressure valve at the base of the water tower.

211.basis: Art Storage (room 10B): the two Virgin Hearts (Red Jewels) are placed on the breast of the two statues in the Storage Room.

212.basis: Power Control Platform (room 702): the Joint N/S plugs go into the high-yield generator to restore power.

213.basis: East Office (room 20B) number lock (op 70, FG_COMMON bit 37): the safe; the BDennis FAQ and the project's own tests/test_map_markers.py (test_safe_hides_after_unlock) identify it.

214.basis: Elevator (room 601): the Master Key is used on the rear console in the main Elevator.

215.basis: Water Pool (room 408): 'Insert the valve handle and rotate it to move the central bridge up or down'.

216.basis: Upper Walkway (room 409): 'Fan regulater. You can stop the rotation of the fan briefly' (Valve Handle).

217.basis: Cog Room (room 111): 'It's a square hole'; the Square Crank lowers the wooden staircase there.

218.basis: Cog Room (room 111): the Gold Cogwheel completes the bell tower mechanism and opens the metal panel.

219.basis: Main Hall 1F (room 200): the Unicorn Medal is used on the 'Statue of a Maiden'.

220.basis: Sewer Passage 2 (room 407): Eagle and Wolf Medals stop the waterfall ('The water is flowing too fast for me to cross').

221.basis: Vacant Factory: the Down Key is used on the Turntable Yard, the Up Key at the Turntable Control Room panel (rooms 504, 503).

222.basis: Main Shaft (rooms 608/611): the Main Fuse goes into the power core at the central point of the Main Shaft.

223.basis: Cold Room (room 60D): the Fuse Case is used on the control panel to make the Main Fuse.

224.basis: Active Treatment Experimentation Room (room 610): 'Activator -VAM- for base vaccine synthesis'; the Vaccine Cart goes into the machine.

225.basis: P-4 Laboratory (room 615): 'A vaccine synthesis machine. The base vaccine must go inside.'

226.basis: Central Corridor (room 616): the MO Disk opens the reinforced door/shutter to the Laboratory Cargo Room from a panel beside it.

227.basis: L Corridor (room 204) and Watchman's Corridor (room 20F): the Cord closes the electric shutters.

228.basis: Chief's Office (room 21B): the Serpent, Jaguar and Eagle Stones go on the panel to open the Chief's secret elevator.

229.basis: Photography Darkroom (room 208): 'I can develop film here.' All four Films are developed there.

230.basis: Helipad Corridor (room 10A): helicopter debris seals the corridor; the Bomb & Detonator blows it open (Event: Detonator and Plastic Bomb).

231.basis: Operations Room (room 206): the Lighter lights the fireplace to release the Virgin Heart.

232.basis: Press Room (room 20D): the Lighter lights the pilot light of the lamps ('lit in the right order') to free the Gold Cogwheel.

233.basis: Sewers (room 403, North Office): the sewer's only Lighter use is lighting the oil lamps (two spots here). Sources label the room 'Warehouse 2' / 'North Office' differently; the object is the same.

234.basis: Cable Car Platform (room 501): the Lighter activates the flare gun to show the Weapon Box Key.

235.basis: Underground Laboratory sleeping quarters (room 60A): the Lighter ignites the fuel on the floor to destroy the vines. Evil Resource calls the room Sleeping Quarters A, Raccoon Insider's room IDs make 60A the B room; the object is the same.

236.basis: Taxidermy Display Room (10E) 'The light switch. Will you push it?' (Claire only) and Active Treatment Experimentation Room (610) 'the operating table stays dark until the switch in the corner is thrown'.

237.basis: Library (room 112): the bookcase puzzle's switches ('A switch to slide the shelf left and right. Will you push it?').

238.basis: Cesspool (room 306): 'A lever to fill and drain water. Will you move it?'

239.basis: East Area (room 60C): the fingerprint lock panel ('2 or more staff need to be present to enter').

240.basis: Active Treatment Experimentation Room (room 610): Claire loads the cart into the machine, 'then work the control panel'. The switch AOT exists for Claire only (Pl1), which matches.

241.basis: Computer Room (room 613): the terminal where staff register ('registered at the Computer Room terminal'); matches the User Registration file.

242.basis: Gate Platform (room 700): the train gate panel, a scenario-B escape objective (extract_overlay.py comment); power is restored to the Gate Platform from the generator.

243.basis: Main Platform (room 701): after the plugs, Leon 'opens the main gate into the train tunnel at the end'; the only interactable in the room besides the item box.

244.basis: Train Front Carriage (room 703): 'What happens here is a lever and a set of gates'.

unresolved.110:sw148: Main Hall 2F: the cited room pages (Raccoon Insider 110) list only doors, the Unicorn Medal recess and zombies; no switch/panel is described, so the object behind this one-shot switch AOT is not identified.
unresolved.309:sw58: Cavernous Walkway (Claire's boss room, Pl1 only): the cited room page lists no interactable object; the switch AOT's object is not identified.
unresolved.605:sw145: Smelting Room: its page shows only the 'Iron smelting pool' sign; the lift switch is documented for the Steam Room (603), not this room, so the object here is not identified.

60A:i47.reason: Public sources disagree on the room label (Evil Resource: Sleeping Quarters A; Raccoon Insider ids: 609 is A, 60A is B). The map draws both 609 and 60A as 'Lounge / 휴게실'.
60A:i47.game_data: ROOM60A0/60A1.RDT hold one Lighter (item 47) use AOT at map (68,125), floor 16, so the marker is in room file 60A whatever the sources call it. The RDT has no readable object text: what the Lighter lights (spilled fuel) is from public sources only.

403:i47.reason: Sources label the room 'Warehouse 2' or 'North Office'; the map draws room 403 as 'North Control Room / 북쪽 관리실'.
403:i47.game_data: ROOM4030/4031.RDT hold two Lighter (item 47) use AOTs at map (243,103) and (272,84), floor 8, matching the two oil-lamp spots of the sources. Object identity (oil lamp) is from public sources only.

610:sw100.reason: Room-based guess between the room's two switch AOTs ('Light Switch').
610:sw100.game_data: FG_COMMON bit 100 is tested and set only inside room 610, for both Leon and Claire; no other room consumes it, so the game data does not say which device it is.

610:sw105.game_data: Bit 105 is tested in room 610 for both players but set only by Claire's script (Pl1), which agrees with a Claire-only control panel; no other room consumes it.

700:sw140.game_data: Bit 140 is tested and set in room 700 and also tested and set in room 703 ('Train Car / 열차 객실'), so the switch is part of the train gate sequence; which object it is stays a guess.

701:sw144.game_data: Bit 144 is tested and set only inside room 701; the game data does not say which object it is.

110:sw148.game_data: Bit 148 is tested and set in room 110 and tested (not set) in room 200 ('Main Hall / 중앙 홀' too): the switch changes something in the other Main Hall, but no object text is readable.

309:sw58.game_data: Pl1 only. Bit 58 is also tested and set in room 303 ('Plug Passage / 플러그 통로'), where it is the chess-plug panel's completion bit for Leon, so this switch may be the chess-plug panel; not applied.

605:sw145.game_data: Bit 145 is set in room 605 and tested in room 602 ('Laboratory Corridor / 연구소 복도'); the project's earlier note calls it the B3 power switch, so 'Power Switch' is a likely name; not applied without a decision.
